title: Regenerate previews its changes: keep or replace, never a blind overwrite

gates._gates_note: every non-zero exit is on foreign paths only, see notes; my files are clean in each

deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: accept/discard idempotent (200 {applied:false}), so api-response.ts, INTERVIEW_PREP_NO_PENDING_PLAN and its catalog entries are dropped; humanScorecards is in acceptance 6's byte-identical list. The diff adds reworded/signalsAdded/signalsRemoved/scenarioChanged/checkedMoved beyond the card (a tick re-attaching to a different block is the sharper consequence of index keys). The modal sends stage:true on all four generate offers (incl. the first-generation empty state); the server commits directly when there is no committed plan (hasCommittedPlan: non-empty chronology, so an erased '{}' pack commits). A PATCH whose plan is neither 'accept' nor 'discard' falls through to the weave path instead of a new code. perf-budget.json raised (11 task-graph route overrides +4 KB, app/page.tsx +2 modules/+14 KB).
